test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. despite pandemic-related travel complications, the

Q. governments of India and France facilitated interactions

R. NPCIL a binding techno-commercial offer on 22 April 2021

S. between EDF and NPCIL which allowed EDF to submit to
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **sentence discusses** the interactions facilitated by the governments of India and France, the submission of a binding techno-commercial offer by NPCIL on 22 April 2021, and how this happened despite pandemic-related travel complications.
 
• Let's **break down the given options:**
 
 
• **P: **despite pandemic-related travel complications, the (correctly connects with the challenges mentioned)
 
• **Q: **governments of India and France facilitated interactions (correctly introduces the interactions facilitated by the governments)
 
• **S:** between EDF and NPCIL which allowed EDF to submit to (correctly follows the mention of EDF and its submission)
 
• **R: **NPCIL a binding techno-commercial offer on 22 April 2021 (correctly concludes the sentence with the mention of the offer)
 
 

Therefore, the **correct arrangement** is: **'PQSR'**
